title: Connecticut SBLR — Decision No. 5327-A — State of Connecticut- Judicial Branch
text:
STATE OF CONNECTICUT
LABOR DEPARTMENT
CONNECTICUT STATE BOARD OF LABOR RELATIONS
_________________________________________
IN THE MATTER OF
State of Connecticut- Judicial Branch
-and-
Local 749, Council 4, AFSCME, AFL-CIO DECISION NO. 5327-A
CASE NO. SE-35060 DATE: AUGUST 29, 2024
DECISION
and
EXPANSION OF UNIT
Pursuant to the Order of Election in Decision No. 5237 dated July 12, 2024, an election
by secret mail ballot was conducted from August 7 through August 21, 2024, under the
supervision of the Connecticut State Board of Labor Relations. The tally of ballots was as
follows:
Number of Ballots Cast . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 7
Number of Ballots Counted . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 7
Number of votes IN FAVOR of Representation. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . …………….. 4
Number of votes NOT IN FAVOR of Representation………………………………………. 3
Number of Blank Ballots . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 0
Number of Void Ballots . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 1
Number of Challenged Ballots . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 0
Copies of the Report Upon Secret Ballot were duly served upon all parties. No
exceptions to the report or objections to the election were filed with the Board.
Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the power vested in the Connecticut State Board
of Labor Relations by the State Employee Relations Act, it is hereby;
DETERMINED, that the existing unit, represented for the purposes of collective
bargaining by Local 749, Council 4, AFSCME, AFL-CIO, is expanded to include all full-time Shift
Managers who are employed by the Judicial Branch, and that said Local 749, Council 4,
AFSCME, AFL-CIO is the exclusive representative of all said employees for the purposes of
collective bargaining with respect to wages, hours and other conditions of employment.
